part.text: Applying all fixes: WiR[3] rotation, dRp/nRp declarations, LZpint/LWpint charge corrections.

## Objective
- Extract the complete new-physics content of the ALRM_general (ALRSM, arXiv:1911.12883) model from the paper into `spec.json` (FeynRulesModel JSON, model_name `"ALRM_general_gen"`), run `./frgen spec.json`, iterate until schema OK and every remaining lint finding individually judged harmless.
- Final deliverable: a self-audit table (each term's charges/sums, signs chosen, roots/fractions verified, lints judged harmless) plus one line with the last `./frgen` result. User directive: continue if next steps exist, else ask for clarification.

## Important Details
- Shell rule: `bash` denied for everything EXCEPT `./frgen spec.json`; use read/write tools otherwise. No web. Do not open cached/reference `.fr` files — directory contains only TASK.md, SM.fr, frgen, tools/, paper/. Nothing outside the working directory may be read.
- Numeric physics values are STRINGS (`"-1/3"`, `"1500."`); SM add-on ⇒ `gauge_groups: []`; indices Colour/Gluon/Generation/SU2D/SU2W need no declaration; other indices need `index_decls`; unique `class_index` per particle; `self_conjugate=false` for complex fields; tensor params need explicit `value_rules`; never name after FR_SYMBOLS/PROTECTED; free-field kinetic+mass term for every new class (rule 1); generation couplings in matrix/class form (rule 13); hierarchy must include NP; (QCD,1) present.
- Schema rules (frmodel.py): External params must be real; `PropArrow` enum `"True"/"False"/"None"/"Forward"`; multi-member classes need `flavor_index` in `indices`.
- Model: SU(3)c × SU(2)L × SU(2)R' × U(1)_{B-L} + global U(1)_S; Q = T3L + T3R + X.
- Paper B−L charges (X): Q_L 1/6, Q_R 1/6, d'_L −1/3, d_R −1/3, L_L −1/2, L_R −1/2, n_L 0, ν_R 0, χ_L/χ_R 1/2, φ 0.
- Paper rotation (lines 462-466): (B, W_L3, W_R3)^T = R_phi·R_tw·R_zw·(A, Z, Z')^T. Derived row 3: W_R3 = s_phi*c_tw·A + (c_phi*s_zw − s_phi*s_tw*c_zw)·Z + (c_phi*c_zw + s_phi*s_tw*s_zw)·Z'. Verified: gR·sphiW·cw = gY·cw = e (photon).
- **WiR[mu,3] current formula WRONG**; correct: `sphiW*cw A[mu] + (cphiW*Sin[thzw] - sphiW*sw*Cos[thzw]) Z[mu] + (cphiW*Cos[thzw] + sphiW*sw*Sin[thzw]) Zp[mu]`. (Current formula gives proportional Z/Zp coefficients — nonsense.) WiR[mu,1]/[mu,2] verified correct (W_R1=(W++W−)/√2, W_R2=i(W+−W−)/√2).
- **Undeclared symbols lint masked** (lint breaks after first per term, requires `s[0].isupper()`, index-pattern includes `ll`): `dRp`, `nRp`, `dqR`, `ll`. Fix: add unphysical F[204] dRp = ProjP[dqp], F[205] nRp = ProjP[nl] (mirror dLp/nlL style); LZpint `dqR`→`dR`, `ll`→`l`.
- **LWpint lepton charged current fails Q conservation**: current `Wp(+1)·lRbar(+1)·nRp(0) = +2`. Correct: `Wp[mu] nRpbar.Ga[mu].lR + Wpbar[mu] lRbar.Ga[mu].nRp` (quark terms already OK: Wp·uRbar(−2/3)·dRp(−1/3)=0).
- **LZpint charge audit (thzw=0, Z'=c_phi·WR3 − s_phi·B ⇒ coupling = gR·cphiW·T3R − gBL·sphiW·X)**:
  - QR term `gR*cphiW/2(uR−dRp) − gBL*sphiW/6(uR+dRp)` ✓ correct.
  - dR/dLp term `+gBL*sphiW/3(dR+dLp)` ✓ correct (X=−1/3).
  - LR T3R signs WRONG: has `−nRp + lR`, should be `+nRp − lR` (nR is upper of L_R=(n_R,e_R)).
  - LR B-L WRONG: needs `+gBL*sphiW/2 (nRp + lR)` (X=−1/2); current has no nRp B-L and `+gBL*sphiW·lR` (factor 1, should be 1/2).
  - LL B-L sign WRONG: needs `+gBL*sphiW/2 (l + vl)`; current has minus.
  - n_L (n1,n2,n3) X=0 ⇒ NO Z' coupling; current `+gBL*sphiW(n1+n2+n3)` must be removed entirely.
  - nur correctly omitted (X=0).
- Proposed corrected LZpint: `Block[{mu}, Zp[mu] (gR*cphiW/2 (uRbar.Ga[mu].uR - dRpbar.Ga[mu].dRp + nRpbar.Ga[mu].nRp - lRbar.Ga[mu].lR) - gBL*sphiW/6 (uRbar.Ga[mu].uR + dRpbar.Ga[mu].dRp) + gBL*sphiW/2 (lbar.Ga[mu].l + vlbar.Ga[mu].vl) + gBL*sphiW/2 (nRpbar.Ga[mu].nRp + lRbar.Ga[mu].lR) + gBL*sphiW/3 (dRbar.Ga[mu].dR + dLpbar.Ga[mu].dLp))]`
- Proposed corrected LWpint: `Block[{mu,sp,sp2,ff,ff2,cc}, gR/Sqrt[2] (Wp[mu] uRbar.Ga[mu].dRp + Wpbar[mu] dRpbar.Ga[mu].uR + Wp[mu] nRpbar.Ga[mu].lR + Wpbar[mu] lRbar.Ga[mu].nRp)]`
- `nl` structure: n_R (X=−1/2, in LR) and n_L (X=0, scotino) are separate Weyl fields sharing class nl; Yukawa `LRbar Yn nlL Eps ChiRbar` charge-balances via χ_R (X=1/2): +1/2 + 0 − 1/2 = 0.
- Lint findings 1 & 2 false positives: `SM_FR` (fr_lint.py:29) = nonexistent external path ⇒ SM_FIELDS_ALL empty ⇒ QLbar warn + Leff fieldless warn. Finding 3 (WiR mixing) intended rule-8 pattern; thzw="0." at BM I.
- Key design decisions: V[100] Zp (PDG 32), V[101] Wp (34), F[100] nl {n1,n2,n3} (6000012/14/16, 756./971./1202., quantum_numbers {LeptonNumber: "2"}), F[101] dqp {dp1,dp2,dp3} (6000001/3/5, 1500./1800./2000.), F[102] nur {vre,vrm,vrt} (−12/−14/−16, 0.), S[100] h0 {H01,H02,H03} (35/45/55), S[101] A0 {A10,A20} (36/46), S[102] Hp {Hp1,Hp2} (37/47), S[103] G0p→Zp (252), S[104] GPp→Wp (253); unphysical V[200] WiR, F[200] QR, F[201] LR, F[202] nlL, F[203] dLp, S[200] PhiB, S[201] ChiL, S[202] ChiR; new F[204] dRp, F[205] nRp pending.
- Index decls: SU2R (NoUnfold, 2, style "r"), Hf (Range, 3, "h"), Af (Range, 2, "a"), Hpf (Range, 2, "p").
- Params: External tb/gR/vevp (SMINPUTS 5/6/7), lam2/lam3/alp1-3/kap (HPOTINPUTS 1-6), Ghgg/Ghaa (EFFECTIVEHIGGS 1-2), Mve/Mvm/MVT, MH02/MH03, Mne/Mnm/Mnt, MDP/MSP/MBP, thzw ("0."). Internal kvev, vLv, vRv, gBL, sphiW, cphiW, MWp, MZp, MH01/MA01/MA02/MHp1/MHp2; Yu/Yd/Ye/Ynu Internal+complex with diagonal value_rules; Ydp/Yn Internal.
- Lagrangian terms: LZpkin, LWpkin, Lnlkin, Ldqpkin, Lnurkin, Lh0kin, LA0kin, LHpkin, LYuk, Lpot, Leff, LWpint, LZpint, LTotal.
- Mass formulas verified vs BM I (MWp≈1460, MZp≈4992, MH01≈193, MA02≈907, MHp1≈906, MHp2≈194).

## Work State

- Read TASK.md, paper source (rotation eq 440-472, effective Lagrangian 513-520, field table ~270, Yukawa 338-343, charge table 265-282), frmodel.py, render.py, fr_lint.py, template, frgen wrapper, SM.fr classes (l=290, vl=273, dR=381, uR=372, lR=352, QL=361; no `ll`/`dqR` classes exist).

- Diagnosed all 3 lint findings as harmless false positives/intended (missing external SM.fr; rule-8 WiR mixing).
- Derived and verified correct WiR[mu,3] rotation formula (incl. photon-coupling check gR·sphiW·cw = e); WiR[mu,1]/[mu,2] verified correct.
- Charge audit of LWpint/LZpint completed: identified all sign/coefficient/removal fixes (list above) plus Q-nonconserving lepton charged-current terms.
- Confirmed nl Yukawa charge balance via χ_R vev.

### Active
